title: Cone residue, the shift-2 core, and the three thresholds pN < pP < p*
summary: An internal item of a twin-prime-parity programme, machine-checked in Lean 4 and Mathlib, and proving no twin-prime or parity result. The cone residue vanishes, conditionally on Tao's log-averaged theorem and unconditionally from S(x)=o(x), but does not imply it. The finite parity split reduces the open core to a sum of lambda over 4k^2-1 and gives only a sufficiency; the correlation has no Euler product and is not a multiplicative convolution. The three-thresholds theorem pN < pP < p* for the rh42 budgets follows from strict antitonicity, four certified brackets and a termwise separation N<P, with no continuity and no root-finding.
